'''Aldecain Damodred''' was a noble from [[Cairhien]]. He was brother of King [[Laman Damodred]] and uncle to [[Moiraine Damodred]].

== History ==
He was a very ambitious, angry and cruel man. He was contemptuous of Moiraine's father for being a scholar. He died with Laman during the [[Aiel War]].{{ref/book|0|5}}
